Then there are other times, maybe for a few days, when I feel like I'm running on rocket fuel. I'll barely sleep, maybe two or three hours, but I'm not tired. My mind races with ideas for side projects, things I used to enjoy but haven't touched in years. I get really talkative too, and sometimes I feel a bit irritable when things don't go my way.     C. Bipolar II Disorder
    D. Binge-Eating Disorder
